question: What powers arise from this practice according to the teaching given to the beloved?
premises: One attainment is knowledge of distant hearing.
Another attainment is the paralysis of bonds.
inference: The practice grants knowledge of hearing from afar and likewise the power to paralyze bonds.
uncertainties: pāśa stobham may mean arresting bonds or arresting others through bonds
plain_english: O beloved, one gains knowledge of hearing from afar and likewise the power to paralyze bonds.
